Use case: stylized-concept, reusable 2D game-art production component. The supplied Master Harbor Scene is the PRIMARY visual reference. Match its precise warm daylight from upper left, rich but restrained illustrated material treatment, fine texture density, crisp softly antialiased edges without ink outlines, near-frontal weak-perspective elevation with shallow/moderate visible top surfaces. DO NOT change its style into cartoon, low poly, pixel art, gritty realism or generic RPG. Warm ivory limestone/plaster, terracotta tiles, honey/umber timber, understated navy and brass, olive foliage. This is ONE isolated reusable asset, NOT another scene, NOT a contact sheet. No text, labels, watermark or border. Entire silhouette fits with padding. Genuine transparent background with no opaque ground/backdrop, no checkerboard pixels, no water or scenery. Keep thin structure opaque with clean transparent gaps; NO cast shadow baked into an opaque ground patch. Render enough resolution for clean downsampling.

ASSET REQUEST:
Create the exact design language of the LARGE THREE-MASTED MERCHANT SHIP in the supplied master as an isolated reusable sprite. Right-facing bow and long bowsprit, left stern with modest navy/wood gallery, coherent rounded plank hull and understated brass. Keep master's refined merchant/exploration identity, never warship, pirate or gun battery. Retain convincing three mast hierarchy, yards, ratlines and carefully connected rigging. ALL sails compact furled cream rolls tied along yards, no hanging scallops, no open triangular sail. Slight visible deck but hull-side dominant, match master view. Show only the above-water hull ending naturally at its waterline, not full underwater keel. No people or quay. All mastheads/bowsprit included. Broad landscape canvas. At final reconstruction this asset will be about 850 px wide; detail must still read at that scale.

Use case: stylized-concept / reusable texture. Reference image supplies ONLY its calm teal WATER material. Produce ONE square SEAMLESS TILEABLE water surface texture for a 2D illustrated harbor game. Fill every pixel edge-to-edge with sheltered medium teal-blue water. Fine broad soft low-energy ripple marks, low contrast gently broken horizontal highlights, subtle variation in depth color. Match the master reference's subdued open water AWAY FROM reflections and objects. No vessels, land, plants, people, sky, horizon, transparency, objects or object reflections. No foam, sharp wave peaks, white glints or isolated bright focal patch. Left matches right and top matches bottom for repeating as a continuous broad harbor surface. No perspective depth gradient, no vignette, no frame. Texture features uniform physical scale, fine at display tile width 512 pixels. Polished painterly material detail, not procedural-looking flat blue or a photograph of open ocean. No text.
